title: Temperature PID
description: Holds a temperature at its setpoint with a heater driven 0-100 % by a PID function block: derivative on the measurement, anti-windup, and a manual mode that switches back to automatic without a jump. The temperature comes from a transmitter over Modbus (a remote I/O module or a link, or a simulator while testing).

tags.name: temperature
tags.description: Measured temperature (°C) from the transmitter (written by a remote I/O module, a link or a simulator)

tags.name: heater
tags.description: Heater output (%), 0 at STOP and on a fault
